- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Major highways servicing Fort Wayne include:

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Interstate 469 circles the city, providing access to eastern suburbs and surrounding communities.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] U.S. Highway 30 runs east-west, connecting to the Ohio state line and cities like Columbia City and Warsaw.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] U.S. Highway 33 runs northeast-southwest, connecting to Goshen, Elkhart, and the Ohio state line.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fort Wayne International Airport (FWA) is located southwest of the city and offers commercial and cargo flights to major cities such as Chicago, Dallas, Detroit, and Atlanta.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Major airlines servicing Fort Wayne International Airport include American, Delta, and United.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Citilink is the public bus system in Fort Wayne, providing regular service throughout the city and surrounding suburbs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The MacArthur Sherwood Shuttle Service provides shuttle service to and from the airport and downtown hotels.
